[Thinking of God as the Vanishing Point at Infinity](https://medium.com/@andy.stein/thinking-of-god-as-the-vanishing-point-at-infinity-11f4dc866fa7),
by Andy Stein on Medium, 1 January 2022.

**Searching for meaning and connection in anything bigger than oneself is a
search for God.** The post starts from years of treating God as about as
likely as aliens hiding behind the moon, and from a lifelong search for meaning
in family, career, hobbies and spiritual communities.

- **The vanishing point.** In a picture of a tree-lined road, the road, the
  trees and the brush are parallel lines that meet at a single
  [vanishing point](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vanishing_point). Family,
  career and community are paths of that kind, and God lies where they meet, at
  infinity.
- **Losing one path.** A death, a lost job or a stagnant community hurts, but
  infinitely many other paths still lead toward the same point.
- **The right direction.** Living well means moving in the right
  direction at each moment, and a prayer can be a prayer for the wisdom to know
  what is right and the strength to do it. Seeing the end of the path is not
  needed.
